SMTO-CFG-0015 — SMTO can't read this conversation's saved settings format

GUID: 0a23da44-d11e-48f2-a2e8-25229786ac4e
Slug: composer-version-unsupported
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: cfg

What happened

  • The settings stored with this conversation, such as its mode and Gateway choices, use a format this copy of SMTO doesn't recognize. SMTO left them as they are and won't use them for new messages here.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If SMTO was recently moved to an older version, or its data was restored from another installation, ask the person who manages SMTO to check Settings › Setup › Server updates. A different settings format usually means another SMTO version saved them, and the matching version can read them.
  2. To keep working now, select New chat in the Conversations pane and send your message there. A new conversation starts with fresh settings in the format this SMTO uses.

What success looks like

  • The old conversation opens without this error after the version is fixed, and your new chat sends messages normally.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it to the person who manages SMTO. Don't delete the conversation; its saved settings are needed to work out what happened and may still be readable.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • ConversationComposerProfile validation rejected the conversation's composer profile because schema_version is not the integer 1 (booleans, strings and other numbers are refused).

What this means

  • Composer profile schema_version is not exactly integer 1, including a boolean masquerading as an integer. Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.

Why this can happen

  • Composer profile schema_version is not exactly integer 1, including a boolean masquerading as an integer.

How to diagnose it

  • Check the stored version's exact type and value while preserving the original profile.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the composer profile stored for this conversation (agent_ui_settings, the conversation's composer namespace, key profile) and its schema_version. Run the SMTO build that wrote it or a supported migration; don't hand-edit or delete the record.
  • Preserve the saved profile and use a compatible application build or supported profile migration.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • A compatible version-1 profile validates through the supported editor/build.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
